svg.title: A list of your active sessions, each one revocable — SoftTrack web design mockup (#308)
svg.desc: A token lasts a week and Sign out everywhere ends every session at once; there is nothing between one and all, and no way to see what all of them is. A session becomes a row made at sign-in, listed under Settings → Security with this device marked, and each one can be revoked while the others continue.

Done when a session is a row created at sign-in with the browser and system, the address, when it began and when it was last used; Settings → Security lists them with this
device marked; one can be revoked while the others continue; Sign out everywhere stays; a session unused for thirty days ends; API tokens stay separate; a site admin sees how
many sessions an account has and can end them all; and tokens issued before this keep working until they expire.
